Review locally first: the CodeRabbit CLI has its own allowance

CodeRabbit PR reviews on the Essentials plan are rate limited per GitHub identity, and every push to an open PR is a new review event. Measured 2026-09-14, the operator's identity sat at the 1 per hour floor with 85% of PR review events in 30 days rate limited. /ork:create-pr now runs coderabbit review --agent against the branch diff in a new Phase 3c, before gh pr create.

Adaptive refill, per identity

Tiers from docs.coderabbit.ai/management/rate-limits: 0 to 29 reviews refills 5 per hour, stepping down to 1 per hour at 60 or more. Only the two endpoints are quoted here; the middle band is shown as "between".

Fix pushes spend PR reviews

Illustrative only: assumes every defect the local pass finds would otherwise have cost one fix push. The local pass uses the CLI allowance, not the PR bucket.

How Phase 3c degrades


    
Every branch ends at Phase 4. The pre-review is advisory and never blocks PR creation.
